t: A tiny RP2040 board with a camera, screen, and microphone for TinyML demos.
steps: Buy a Pico4ML from a shop with stock such as Core Electronics, or look for the Pico4ML-Pro from Arducam.
Get a micro USB data cable.
Install the Raspberry Pi Pico C SDK and Visual Studio Code on your computer.
Download the ArduCAM pico-tflmicro example code from GitHub.
Copy the built file onto the board over USB.
Point the camera at yourself and watch the result on the screen.
Try the magic wand and wake word examples next.
meta: Open Board. From $25.99. A few stores.
